dec.pe: Botswana’s law gave citizenship to children through their father only. A woman married to an American challenged it. The court said the law was unfair to women.
dec.pi: UU Botswana memberikan kewarganegaraan kepada anak hanya melalui ayah. Seorang perempuan yang menikah dengan warga AS menggugatnya. Pengadilan menyatakan UU itu tidak adil bagi perempuan.

dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: A politician in Botswana was told he was not a citizen and was sent to South Africa several times, ending up in a homeland area with no status. The African Commission said Botswana had broken the Charter.
dec.pi: Seorang politisi di Botswana dinyatakan bukan warga negara dan beberapa kali dikirim ke Afrika Selatan, hingga terdampar di wilayah homeland tanpa status. Komisi Afrika menyatakan Botswana melanggar Piagam.

dec.pe: A foreign professor was expelled from Botswana after writing an article critical of the government. The highest court said the President could do this without explaining why. The African Commission later disagreed.
dec.pi: Seorang dosen asing diusir dari Botswana setelah menulis artikel yang mengkritik pemerintah. Pengadilan tertinggi menyatakan Presiden boleh melakukannya tanpa menjelaskan alasan. Komisi Afrika kemudian berpendapat lain.

dec.ct: African Commission on Human and Peoples’ Rights
dec.pe: A foreign professor in Botswana wrote an article criticising how presidents were chosen and was declared a prohibited immigrant. The African Commission found this breached his rights.
dec.pi: Seorang dosen asing di Botswana menulis artikel yang mengkritik cara memilih presiden dan dinyatakan imigran terlarang. Komisi Afrika menyatakan haknya dilanggar.
